    Plot Rhythms for Selected Genes

    plot_rhythms.Rd

    This function generates plots for pseudobulk expression and double-frequency variance for selected genes.

    plot_rhythms(
  times,
  var_mat,
  mean_mat,
  plot_me = c(),
  time_units = "hrs",
  line_thickness = 1,
  point_size = 3,
  line_color = "red",
  point_color = "blue"
)

    Arguments

    times

    A numeric vector of time points (e.g., ZT times, or radians).

    var_mat

    A matrix of variance data (genes x samples).

    mean_mat

    A matrix of mean expression data (genes x samples).

    plot_me

    A character vector of gene symbols to plot.

    time_units

    A string indicating the time units ("hrs" for hours or "radians" for radians). Default is "hrs".

    line_thickness

    A numeric value specifying the thickness of the lines in the plots. Default is 1.

    point_size

    A numeric value specifying the size of the points in the plots. Default is 3.

    line_color

    A string specifying the color of the lines in the plots. Default is "red".

    point_color

    A string specifying the color of the points in the plots. Default is "blue".

    Value

    Generates side-by-side plots for pseudobulk expression and double-frequency variance for the selected genes.
